                continue
            stack = [(r, c)]
            seen.add((r, c))
            cells = []

                y, x = stack.pop()
                cells.append((y, x))

                    p = (y + dy, x + dx)

                            and grid[p[0]][p[1]] == 2 and p not in seen):
                        seen.add(p)
                        stack.append(p)
            boxes.append((min(y for y, x in cells), min(x for y, x in cells),
                          max(y for y, x in cells), max(x for y, x in cells)))

                        if r <= y <= _ and c <= x:
                            pass
            # Fill this component by flood fill.
            todo = [(r, c)]
            visited = {(r, c)}
            while todo:
                y, x = todo.pop()

                            and (ny, nx) not in visited):

    return out
